name: CogACT
summary: CogACT componentizes a VLA into a VLM cognition module and a specialized diffusion transformer action module conditioned on the VLM's output token, rather than making the VLM emit actions itself. The paper studies how action-module capacity scales given a fixed backbone and reports large gains over OpenVLA in both simulation and real manipulation with modest fine-tuning.
innovation: Systematic study of action-module architecture and scaling with the VLM held fixed.
Adaptive action ensembling across predicted chunks to smooth execution.
matters: Gave empirical backing to the now-standard VLM-plus-action-expert factorization.
limits: Evaluation leans on simulation benchmarks; real-robot breadth is narrow.
lineage: OpenVLA's backbone with Diffusion Policy's generative head, formalized as separate modules.
